criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Build an appropriate neural-network classifier with documented architecture and reproducible training settings.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Encode and scale correctly, prevent leakage and use validation, early stopping or regularization when suitable.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate on held-out data and compare training/validation metrics to assess overfitting and errors.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare neural network with a selected ML baseline on the same held-out records and metrics.

criteria.name: NLP Implementation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Use supplied healthcare education text for a defined text task; provide valid evidence and do not portray generated text as medical advice.
